population: actual successful publication attempt/result pairs; retained decisions only; not all scheduled cycles
benchmark_preserved: existing first-original-per-local-day population and original scores unchanged
decision_clock: original attempt started_at; availability requires actual original first_seen and completed at or before decision
delivery_clock: outer result completed_at; only targets strictly later than confirmed publication completion enter prospective serving scores

source_classes.latest_48h_collection: latest known complete retained48h collection covering next24h; collected horizon does not prove nominal provider product class
source_classes.latest_360h_collection: latest known complete retained360h collection covering next24h
source_classes.actual_serving: source-replayed original published near/extended composite with per-target profile identity
source_classes.near_term_local_correction_24h_v1: separate prepared candidate from same native near source for origin bias and future features; only actually acquired origin and original selected model available by decision

comparisons: latest48 versus latest360 raw temperature on identical decision/target/qualified-observation tuples
actual served raw versus latest48/latest360 on identical tuples
independent near24 corrected versus same-source raw, matched support plus full raw-fallback policy
support_and_weights: frozen general evaluation-protocol.json: date then target then forecast equal weights; no repeated observation counted as independent
quality_cohorts: separate sensor epoch, measurement quality class, native grid, source availability basis, profile and model artifact/policy
fit_policy: no fitting or model promotion in refresh raw-policy assessment; selected residual artifact remains original and source-bound
